data.name: Graph_user_sourceOfAuthority
data.value: Where the user is managed, derived by JIM: cloud (in Entra ID, so JIM can write to it through Microsoft Graph), onPremisesDirectory (synchronised from Active Directory, so most attributes are written there instead) or externalEntraDirectory (a guest from another tenant). An object whose Source of Authority was switched to Entra ID reads as cloud only with Track Source of Authority Changes on. Flow it into a Metaverse Attribute to scope export Synchronisation Rules on it.
data.comment: The description of the Microsoft Entra ID Connector's "sourceOfAuthority" user attribute, shown on the Schema tab. Attribute names stay in English.
